summary: Evaluate the license against a clock high-water mark
description: FR-C7-12. If the clock reads earlier than the latest timestamp already seen, evaluate the license at that high-water mark. The mark stays in memory in this task.
scope: observe() advances the mark and never moves it backward
A rolled-back clock still expires a license the mark has passed
acceptanceCriteria: After observe('2026-10-09T00:00:00Z'), a clock now of 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z evaluates as expired for expires_at 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z and grace_days 7. The same now without the mark is grace. observe of an earlier timestamp does not lower the mark. FR-C7-12 T7.
constraints: Do not write the mark to disk in this task.
Do not ignore the mark when the clock goes backward.
Do not move the mark backward.
